profile_id.description: Short ID used for selecting a profile via MCP4_PROFILE or --profile

profile_aliases.description: Alternate IDs that can be used to select this profile via MCP4_PROFILE or --profile

openapi_spec_path.description: OpenAPI spec path used when launching by profile without MCP4_OPENAPI_SPEC_PATH

description.description: Human-readable description of what this profile provides

tools.description: List of MCP tools defined in this profile

parameter_aliases.description: Map parameter names to their aliases (e.g., 'id' -> ['project_id', 'group_id'])

resource_name.description: OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource name (overrides OpenAPI info.title). Defaults to 'MCP Server' if not specified.

resource_documentation.description: OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource documentation URL (overrides OpenAPI externalDocs.url). Omitted if not specified.

name.description: Tool name (must be unique, lowercase with underscores)

description.description: Clear description of what this tool does (shown to LLM)

operations.description: Map action names to OpenAPI operationIds or proxy download operations

composite.description: If true, this tool chains multiple API calls

partial_results.description: If true, return partial results even if some steps fail (composite only)

metadata_params.description: Parameter names that are metadata (not sent in API request body)

response_fields.description: Define which fields to include in response for each action (reduces verbosity)

send_response_fields_as_param.description: If true, send response_fields as 'fields' query parameter (e.g. for YouTrack)

OperationDefinition.description: Extended operation definition supporting multipart uploads and proxy_download

metadata_endpoint.description: OpenAPI operation ID to fetch metadata (e.g., 'get_/issues/{id}/attachments/{attachmentId}')

download_endpoint.description: OpenAPI operation ID for direct download endpoint when metadata does not expose a URL

url_field.description: JSON path to URL field in metadata response

max_size_bytes_from_env.description: Environment variable that overrides max_size_bytes when set

skip_auth.description: Skip authentication for download URL (default: false). Set to true for pre-signed URLs.

allowed_hosts.description: Optional allowlist of host patterns for cross-origin downloads when skip_auth=true (e.g., ["cdn.example.com", "*.example.com"])

allow_private_network.description: SSRF safety switch: when skip_auth=true, controls whether proxy_download may fetch from localhost and private/loopback/link-local IPs (including hostnames that resolve to them) (default: false)

ProxyDownloadOperation.description:
Proxy download operation configuration

Why: Some APIs return file URLs that require authentication. LLM cannot fetch these directly, so we proxy the download.

operationId.description: OpenAPI operation ID for the multipart endpoint

file_field_name.description: Multipart field name for the uploaded file

store_as.description: JSON path where to store result (e.g., 'merge_request', 'merge_request.comments')

description.description: Clear description of this parameter (shown to LLM)

required_for.description: List of actions this parameter is required for

properties.description: Properties schema for object parameters (empty {} = free-form object)

key_field.description: Field name to store the object key

value_field.description: Field name to store the object value

wrap_value_field.description: Optional wrapper field name for non-object values

object_entries_to_array.description: Convert an object map into an array of objects using key/value fields

key_field.description: Field name to store the array item value

array_item_to_object.description: Convert primitive array items into objects using the provided field

oneOf.description: Multiple authentication methods (tried in order of priority)

array_format.description: How to serialize array query parameters

Interceptors.description: HTTP interceptor configuration (auth, rate limiting, retry)

priority.description: Priority for multi-auth (lower = higher priority). Default: 0. Used when multiple auth methods are configured.

header_name.description: Custom header name (required for custom-header type)

query_param.description: Query parameter name (required for query type)

value_from_env.description: Environment variable name containing the auth token (required for bearer, query, custom-header)

oauth_config.description:
OAuth 2.0 configuration

Supports Authorization Code Flow with PKCE (RFC 7636)
Only available in HTTP transport mode

Client registration can be:
- Static: pre-registered client_id and client_secret
- Dynamic: RFC 7591 dynamic client registration

max_requests.description: Maximum number of OAuth requests allowed per window

oauth_rate_limit.description: OAuth rate limiting configuration. Overrides default OAuth rate limits (10 requests per 15 minutes).

Auth.description:
Auth interceptor configuration

- bearer: Standard HTTP Bearer token (Authorization: Bearer <token>)
- query: API key in query string (?api_key=<token>)
- custom-header: Custom header name (e.g., X-API-Key: <token>)
- oauth: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Flow with PKCE (HTTP transport only)

Multi-auth support:
- When multiple auth methods are provided as array, they are tried in order
- priority field determines the order (lower = higher priority)
- First successful authentication is used

Token validation (optional):
- validation_endpoint: API endpoint to verify token validity (e.g., "/api/v4/user")
- Validates token during initialization to fail fast with invalid tokens
- Improves UX by rejecting bad tokens immediately, not after first tool call

oauth_rate_limit.description: OAuth rate limiting configuration. Overrides default OAuth rate limits (10 requests per 15 minutes).

max_requests.description: Maximum number of OAuth requests allowed per window

issuer.description: OAuth 2.0 issuer URL (RFC 8414). When provided, authorization_endpoint and token_endpoint are auto-derived via /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server or standard paths. Supports ${env:VAR} syntax.

authorization_endpoint.description: OAuth 2.0 authorization endpoint. Optional if issuer is provided. Supports ${env:VAR} syntax.

token_endpoint.description: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint. Optional if issuer is provided. Supports ${env:VAR} syntax.

client_id.description: Pre-registered OAuth client ID (supports ${env:VAR} syntax). Optional for dynamic registration.

client_secret.description: Pre-registered OAuth client secret (supports ${env:VAR} syntax). Optional for public clients.

scopes.description: OAuth 2.0 scopes to request. Optional - if not provided, no scopes will be requested (some APIs don't require scopes)

registration_endpoint.description: Client registration endpoint for dynamic registration (RFC 7591)

allowed_redirect_hosts.description:
Optional: Allowed redirect hosts for OAuth callbacks
Used to prevent open redirect vulnerabilities

Supports wildcards: "*.example.com" matches any subdomain
Defaults to ["localhost", "127.0.0.1"] for security

Can reference MCP4_ALLOWED_ORIGINS environment variable

allow_unregistered_clients.description: Optional: Allow authorize requests for OAuth client IDs that are not registered on the current instance, but only when redirect_uri matches an approved rule. Disabled by default.

allowed_unregistered_redirect_uris.description:
Optional: Approved redirect URI rules for unregistered OAuth clients. Examples:
- "http://localhost"
- "http://127.0.0.1"
- "cursor://"
- "cursor://anysphere.cursor-mcp"

OAuthConfig.description: OAuth 2.0 configuration. Must provide EITHER 'issuer' (endpoints auto-derived) OR both 'authorization_endpoint' and 'token_endpoint' (explicit).

login_endpoint.description: Login endpoint path or absolute URL. Relative paths are resolved against the profile base_url.

login_method.description: HTTP method for login. Currently only POST is supported.

username_field.description: Login form field name for username/login identifier.

username_from_env.description: Environment variable containing the login username.

password_field.description: Login form field name for password.

password_from_env.description: Environment variable containing the login password.

login_static_headers.description: Optional extra headers to send with the login request.

login_static_body.description: Optional extra fields to include in the login request body.

cookie_names.description: Allowed session cookie names accepted from Set-Cookie. At least one matching cookie must be returned by login.

login_allowed_hosts.description: Optional allowlist for absolute login endpoints beyond the profile base URL host. Supports exact hosts and *.example.com wildcards.

reauth_on_statuses.description: HTTP status codes that should trigger relogin and a single replay attempt.

failure_backoff_ms.description: Backoff applied after failed login/relogin to avoid login storms.

expiry_skew_ms.description: Treat cookies expiring within this skew window as expired.

SessionCookieConfig.description:
Session cookie authentication configuration

Supports direct server-to-server login flows where the API exchanges username/password for a session cookie instead of issuing API tokens.

value_from_env.description: Environment variable name containing the base URL

default.description: Default base URL if environment variable is not set

max_requests_per_minute.description: Maximum number of requests per minute (token bucket algorithm)

backoff_ms.description: Backoff delays in milliseconds (one per attempt)

retry_on_status.description: HTTP status codes that trigger retry

mode.description: 'required' (default): reject session if no valid identity resolved. 'optional': allow anonymous sessions.

api_keys.description: API key store config. Phase 4 adds jwt?: ClientAuthJwtConfig.

ClientAuthGateConfig.description:
Client authentication gate configuration.

Defines how the gateway authenticates inbound MCP clients before any tool call is processed. Phase 3 supports API keys only; Phase 4 adds an OIDC JWT gate via a future `jwt?: ClientAuthJwtConfig` field on this interface.

ApiKeyStoreConfig.description:
Backing store for client API keys.

Phase 3 supports only `'inline'` - keys defined directly on the profile and resolved from env vars. Phase 4 will extend the union to include `{ type: 'sasanka'; ... }` for the centralized key service.

key_from_env.description: Env var name containing the raw API key value.

subject.description: Subject identifier for this key (mapped to AuthorizedPrincipal.subject).

scopes.description: Optional scopes granted to this key.

InlineApiKeyEntry.description:
Inline API key entry for the client auth gate.

Used by `ApiKeyStoreConfig` of type `'inline'`. Each entry references an environment variable that holds the raw API key value (so secrets stay out of profile JSON) and maps that key to a stable subject identity.

required.description: When true, upstream MCP tool calls are blocked until consent is recorded for the subject + rules_version.

rules_version.description: Opaque version of the rules/education content; changing it invalidates prior consent.

education_resource.description: Optional URL to educational content shown during the consent flow.

rules_summary.description: Optional short human-readable summary of the rules shown at consent time.

max_age_days.description: Optional maximum age of a grant in days; an older grant forces re-acceptance.

identity_source.description: Identity source used to bind consent evidence to an authenticated human.

template_path.description: Optional path (relative to the profile file, or absolute) of a full-page HTML template for the consent screens. Must contain the `{{consent_body}}` placeholder, which the server replaces with the security-owned block (the approval form, the info block, or the expired block). Cosmetic only: the template is deliberately NOT part of the rules hash, so a layout/CSS change does not force re-consent; the consent-meaningful record stays in `rules_version`, `rules_summary`, `education_resource` and `labels`.

template.description: Resolved template markup. Filled by the profile loader from `template_path`; may also be authored inline. Same `{{consent_body}}` requirement and hashing semantics as `template_path`.

accept.description: Checkbox label. Default: `I accept rules version <rules_version>`.

submit.description: Submit button label. Default: `Continue to sign in`.

labels.description: Consent-meaningful texts rendered inside the approval form. Part of the rules hash: changing them invalidates existing grants, because they define what the subject agreed to. `{{rules_version}}` inside `accept` is substituted at render time.

ConsentGateConfig.description:
Consent gate configuration.

Gates sensitive profiles (e.g. an upstream MS365 MCP) behind a provable, human consent: the user must complete an interactive OAuth login and accept the current rules before any upstream MCP tool call is dispatched. Consent is bound to the authenticated subject and the `rules_version`; bumping `rules_version` invalidates prior consent and forces re-acceptance.

The gate is deliberately NOT an MCP tool, so an autonomous agent cannot grant consent on the user's behalf.

name.description: Stable provider name used for namespacing, logs, and policy.

auth.description: Optional auth from mcp4openapi to the upstream MCP server.

tool_prefix.description: Optional prefix applied when exposing upstream tools downstream.

tools.description: Optional allow/deny policy for upstream tool exposure.

timeout_ms.description: Optional request timeout for upstream MCP calls.

html_description_policy.description:
Controls how HTML tags in upstream tool descriptions and inputSchema are handled.
- drop (default): tools containing HTML chars (<, >, backtick) are dropped
- strip: HTML tags are stripped from descriptions/schema string values; tool is kept
- allow: HTML checks are skipped entirely; tool passes through as-is

tool_description_length_policy.description:
Controls how upstream tools with descriptions exceeding the internal length limit are handled.
- drop (default): tools with overlong descriptions are dropped
- truncate: description is truncated to the limit; tool is kept
- allow: description length check is skipped; tool passes through unchanged

validation_endpoint.description: Optional endpoint to validate upstream credentials at session init (fail-fast).

validation_method.description: HTTP method for validation probe. Default: 'HEAD'.

validation_timeout_ms.description: Timeout for validation probe in ms. Default: 5000.

UpstreamMcpServerConfig.description:
Upstream MCP provider configuration

Why: MCP proxy support needs a transport-agnostic provider boundary so remote MCP discovery/invocation can evolve without overloading the OpenAPI profile model. The first iteration supports only remote HTTP streamable MCP upstreams.

UpstreamMcpAuthConfig.description: Upstream auth is intentionally narrower than inbound profile auth. Secrets must be referenced via environment variables, never stored inline.
